entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes, I... I need to return something, I think. I'm a bit lost with all this. The website was confusing.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have an order number I can look up for you?
Uh, let me see. Yes, it's VF886-0920. It's for the cycling shoes.
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order from about twelve weeks ago. What specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

I just... they're not working for me. I keep getting terrible blisters, even after I tried adjusting the cleats like the instructions said. I read the policy online but didn't really get it. I just want a refund. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm here to help. I understand the frustration with blisters. Let me just confirm our policy for you.
Okay, I've checked. Since your purchase was 84 days ago, you are still well within our 90-day return window for standard items like these shoes. I can absolutely process that return for you.
Oh, really? That's a relief! So I can get my money back?

Yes. I've just initiated the process. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on your account now. Just box up the shoes, attach the label, and drop them off. Once we receive them, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method.
Wow, thank you so much, Diana. You've made this so much easier than I thought it would be.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
